This separate allocation experiment binds grouped expert execution to affine3-grouped-memory-v1. The phase ledger charges owned reads, padded expert groups, retained padded output allocations, route restoration, two hot-record sets while concatenating, and the largest destination-piece replacement. The preflight, per-process ten-GB ceiling and three-GB real headroom remain unchanged. The source hypothesis and pinned MLX ownership/dispatch evidence precede execution.

The first catalogue attempt stops before any model. A new assertion wrongly expected the grouped reservation to be smaller even at complete model residency. At that capacity retained hot copies can cost more. The repaired test restricts that comparison to its declared smaller capacity domain; it neither changes nor relaxes the memory formula. Both successful builds, the failed catalogue and corrected run are retained.

The final source-frozen CLI adc9396a5f27f9ec740888f4cdf76ee58e502b1e4f98ad28875d18f9b5a6c3d8 passes the complete native catalogue, nineteen input/protocol refusal cases, speculation, Engine and 32K staged context. Speculation retains all twenty-three prior token and committed-state observations; Engine retains prior results and recovery behavior. Context completes sixty-four checkpoints. The respective process-tree peaks are 1,439,450,384, 6,217,847,392, 6,617,650,168 and 7,833,505,584 bytes for catalogue, speculation, Engine and context. The unchanged grouped component/admission implementation reuses its earlier independently frozen complete gate; it is not claimed as rerun here.

The profile remains explicit research with unknown speed, no vision and no Auto qualification. This closes the functional allocation experiment, not timing, held-out quality, standalone distribution or product acceptance. Raw timings are operational diagnostics only. No raw full-vocabulary logits, new weights, installed artifacts or supported-pack changes are produced.

Local home prefixes are replaced with <HOME>. Original lengths and SHA-256 identify the unmodified files. Large or whitespace-bearing normalized UTF-8 transcripts are losslessly zlib-compressed and base64 encoded. Decode with `zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(block))` and check the normalized digest. Every encoded block is verified before writing. Frozen binaries, source archives and weights remain in bounded local staging; the receipts bind their exact bytes.

### .build/quantization-research/freeze-affine-grouped-memory-v1.py

Normalized bytes: 1216. SHA-256: `fe1187874df2e8448e90585cffb99c3b10d4472e6d7cf8958aab66376a9df6b6`.

````text
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,tarfile
r=Path('.build/quantization-research');build=r/'affine-grouped-memory-build-v1';out=r/'frozen-affine-grouped-memory-v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert json.loads((build/'receipt.json').read_text())['complete']
before=(build/'inputs-before.json').read_bytes();assert before==(build/'inputs-after.json').read_bytes()
assert before==subprocess.check_output(['python3','Tools/mac_build_inputs.py',str(Path.home()/'.dbmd/bin/dbmd')])
m=json.loads(before)
assert all(sha(p)==digest for p,digest in m['files'].items())
out.mkdir()
for name in ('slotstream','slotstream-checks','mlx.metallib'):shutil.copy2(Path('.build/release')/name,out/name)
with tarfile.open(out/'sources.tar.gz','w:gz') as archive:
 for p in sorted(m['files']):archive.add(p,arcname=p)
identity={'binary_sha256':sha(out/'slotstream'),'checks_sha256':sha(out/'slotstream-checks'),'metallib_sha256':sha(out/'mlx.metallib'),'source_archive_sha256':sha(out/'sources.tar.gz'),'build_inputs':m}
````

````text
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,tarfile
r=Path('.build/quantization-research');build=r/'affine-grouped-memory-build-v2';out=r/'frozen-affine-grouped-memory-v2'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert json.loads((build/'receipt.json').read_text())['complete']
before=(build/'inputs-before.json').read_bytes();assert before==(build/'inputs-after.json').read_bytes()
assert before==subprocess.check_output(['python3','Tools/mac_build_inputs.py',str(Path.home()/'.dbmd/bin/dbmd')])
m=json.loads(before)
assert all(sha(p)==digest for p,digest in m['files'].items())
out.mkdir()
for name in ('slotstream','slotstream-checks','mlx.metallib'):shutil.copy2(Path('.build/release')/name,out/name)
with tarfile.open(out/'sources.tar.gz','w:gz') as archive:
 for p in sorted(m['files']):archive.add(p,arcname=p)
identity={'binary_sha256':sha(out/'slotstream'),'checks_sha256':sha(out/'slotstream-checks'),'metallib_sha256':sha(out/'mlx.metallib'),'source_archive_sha256':sha(out/'sources.tar.gz'),'build_inputs':m}
(out/'build-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in identity.items() if k!='build_inputs'}))
````

### .build/quantization-research/run-affine-grouped-memory-v1.py

Original bytes: 7089. SHA-256: `dcc5d7ac263d464fe8919de02d3ed5568e92b1f441787fb20b217142bfbc2528`.

Normalized bytes: 7082. SHA-256: `09102b6c8091584ce1820f09adce2a9021751642dd0bd8c15e38d968cb708919`.

````text
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes,ctypes.util,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'Tools')
from context_qualification import quiet_preflight
from prefill_bench import terminate_child_tree,vm_snapshot
r=Path('.build/quantization-research').absolute();out=r/'affine-grouped-memory-v1';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
protocol=json.loads((r/'affine-grouped-memory-resource-v1.json').read_text());cli=r/'frozen-affine-grouped-memory-v1/slotstream';binary=sha(cli)

assert json.loads((cli.parent/'build-identity.json').read_text())['binary_sha256']==binary
record={'schema':1,'complete':False,'qualification':False,'scope':'Explicit grouped affine allocation contract with owned-allocation bounds. Three sequential model processes; no timing or quality qualification.','binary_sha256':binary,'runs':[]}
save=lambda:(out/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
env=dict(os.environ)
for key in list(env):
 if key.startswith(('SLOTSTREAM_','SS_DEBUG','VQ_','VQLAB_')):del env[key]
base='<HOME>/.slotstream/models/qwen38-flash-next-mlx-4bit'
common=[str(cli),'affine-engine-check','--baseline',base,
 '--control',str(r/'affine-expert-control-pack-v1'),
 '--table',str(r/'vq-extended-rotary-v1/rotary-output/angles-f32le.bin'),
 '--generation-profile',str(Path('bench/quantization/greedy-v1.json').absolute())]
native=[str(cli),'affine-speculation-check','--baseline',base,'--control',str(r/'affine-expert-control-pack-v1'),'--generation-profile',str(Path('bench/quantization/greedy-v1.json').absolute()),'--streamed-draft','--piecewise-allocation','--grouped-experts','--output',str(out/'speculation')]
commands=[
 ('catalogue',[str(cli.parent/'slotstream-checks'),'--tier','t0','--tier','t1','--json'],6),
 ('speculation',native,10),
 ('engine',common+['--output',str(out/'engine'),'--draft','--streamed-draft','--piecewise-allocation','--grouped-experts'],10),
 ('context',[str(cli),'affine-context-check','--baseline',base,'--control',str(r/'affine-expert-control-pack-v1'),'--table',str(r/'vq-extended-rotary-v1/rotary-output/angles-f32le.bin'),'--limit','32768','--streamed-draft','--piecewise-allocation','--grouped-experts','--output',str(out/'context')],10),
]
reference=r/'affine-piecewise-v1/speculation/receipt.json'
reference_sha=sha(reference)
assert json.loads(reference.read_text())['complete']
allocated=sum(p.stat().st_blocks*512 for p in r.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
assert allocated+protocol['maximum_temporary_weight_copy_bytes']+protocol['maximum_new_receipt_bytes']<protocol['maximum_research_staging_bytes']
assert __import__('shutil').disk_usage(r).free>protocol['maximum_temporary_weight_copy_bytes']+3_000_000_000
record['research_allocated_bytes_before']=allocated
record['prior_speculation_reference_sha256']=reference_sha
component_reference=r/'affine-grouped-integration-v1/component/receipt.json'
assert json.loads(component_reference.read_text())['complete']
record['component_reference_sha256']=sha(component_reference)
record['component_gate_sha256']=sha(r/'affine-grouped-integration-v1/receipt.json')
engine_reference=r/'affine-piecewise-v1/engine/receipt.json'
record['engine_reference_sha256']=sha(engine_reference)
record['resource_protocol_sha256']=sha(r/'affine-grouped-memory-resource-v1.json')
record['source_identity_sha256']=sha(cli.parent/'build-identity.json')
record['driver_sha256']=sha(__file__)
record['commands']=commands;save()

lib=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('proc'));child=None;start=time.monotonic()
try:
 for name,command,limit in commands:
  before=quiet_preflight(limit+3);row={'case':name,'command':command,'before':before,'maximum_process_bytes':int(limit*1e9),'peak_tree_bytes':0,'samples':0};record['runs'].append(row);save();started=time.monotonic()
  with (out/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
   child=subprocess.Popen(command,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
   while child.poll() is None:
    rows=[tuple(map(int,line.split())) for line in subprocess.check_output(['ps','-axo','pid=,ppid='],text=True,timeout=5).splitlines()];pids={child.pid}
    while True:
     more=pids|{pid for pid,parent in rows if parent in pids}
     if more==pids:break
     pids=more
    total=0
    for pid in pids:
     b=ctypes.create_string_buffer(296)
     if lib.proc_pid_rusage(pid,4,b)==0:total+=max(int.from_bytes(b.raw[72:80],'little'),int.from_bytes(b.raw[240:248],'little'))
    row['peak_tree_bytes']=max(row['peak_tree_bytes'],total);row['samples']+=1
    if total>limit*1e9:raise RuntimeError('process envelope exceeded')
    if vm_snapshot()['reclaimable_bytes']<3e9:raise RuntimeError('lost three-GB real headroom')
    if subprocess.check_output(['sysctl','-n','kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level'],text=True,timeout=5).strip()!='1':raise RuntimeError('OS memory pressure')
    if time.monotonic()-started>1800 or time.monotonic()-start>7200:raise RuntimeError('time envelope exceeded')
    time.sleep(.25)
   row['exit_code']=child.returncode;row['seconds']=time.monotonic()-started;row['after']=vm_snapshot();save()
   if child.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' failed; dependent phases not run')
   child=None
  if name=='engine':
   previous=json.loads(engine_reference.read_text());current=json.loads((out/'engine/receipt.json').read_text())
   assert current['complete'] and current['report']['passed'] and current['grouped_experts']
   by_case={v['case']:v for v in current['observations']}
   for old in previous['observations']:
    new=by_case[old['case']]
    for key in ['ids','repeat_ids','memory_ids','disk_ids','cold_ids','recovered_ids','grown_ids']:
     if key in old:assert old[key]==new[key],(old['case'],key)
    if old['case']=='http':assert old['body']['response']==new['body']['response']
   assert current['resource_identity']=='affine3-grouped-memory-v1'
   record['exact_engine_observations']=True;save()
  if name=='context':
   current=json.loads((out/'context/receipt.json').read_text())
   assert current['complete'] and current['report']['passed'] and current['grouped_experts'] and current['context_limit']==32768
  if name=='speculation':
   assert sha(reference)==reference_sha
   previous=json.loads(reference.read_text());current=json.loads((out/'speculation/receipt.json').read_text())
   assert current['complete'] and current['piecewise_allocation'] and current['streamed_draft'] and current['grouped_experts'] and current['report']['passed']
   by_name={v['name']:v for v in current['observations']}
   for old in previous['observations']:
    new=by_name[old['name']]
    for key in ['ids','consumed','state','prompt_count']:
     assert old.get(key)==new.get(key),(old['name'],key)
   record['exact_resident_observations_matched']=len(previous['observations']);save()

 assert sha(cli)==binary
 record['complete']=True
except BaseException as error:
 record['failure']=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)
 if child is not None and child.poll() is None:terminate_child_tree(child)
 save();raise
finally:save()
print(json.dumps(record))
````

### .build/quantization-research/check-affine-grouped-inputs-v1.py

Original bytes: 3879. SHA-256: `49431dc943b0a24d3802cd0cd1c0e33a1163b8d9591526e684de668ecb94e647`.

Normalized bytes: 3879. SHA-256: `49431dc943b0a24d3802cd0cd1c0e33a1163b8d9591526e684de668ecb94e647`.

````text
from pathlib import Path
import copy,hashlib,json,os,subprocess
r=Path('.build/quantization-research').absolute();out=r/'affine-grouped-inputs-v1';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
cli=r/'frozen-affine-grouped-memory-v2/slotstream'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert json.loads((cli.parent/'build-identity.json').read_text())['binary_sha256']==sha(cli)
protocol=json.loads((r/'affine-planned-tasks-protocol-v1.json').read_text())
record={'schema':1,'complete':False,'model_processes':0,'scope':'CLI refuses invalid planned evaluation inputs before opening model metadata; valid input reaches only the intentionally absent metadata directory.','binary_sha256':sha(cli),'driver_sha256':sha(__file__),'cases':[]}
def save():(out/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('SLOTSTREAM_','SS_DEBUG','VQ_','VQLAB_'))}
common=['--engine-plan','--streamed-draft','--draft-depth','2']
affine=common+['--affine-control','absent','--table','absent']
cases=[('undeclared-groups',{},affine+['--piecewise-allocation','--grouped-experts'],'freeze its explicit draft'),
       ('groups-without-pieces',{'affine_allocation':'grouped'},affine+['--grouped-experts'],'explicit paired artifacts'),
       ('declared-groups',{'affine_allocation':'grouped'},affine+['--piecewise-allocation','--grouped-experts'],'cannot read evaluation input'),
       ('declared-groups-without-flag',{'affine_allocation':'grouped'},affine+['--piecewise-allocation'],'freeze its explicit draft'),
       ('baseline-in-grouped-protocol',{'affine_allocation':'grouped'},common,'cannot read evaluation input'),
       ('undeclared-pieces',{},affine+['--piecewise-allocation'],'freeze its explicit draft'),
       ('unknown-allocation',{'affine_allocation':'guessed'},affine,'freeze its explicit draft'),
       ('pieces-without-control',{},common+['--piecewise-allocation'],'explicit paired artifacts'),
       ('pieces-without-plan',{},['--piecewise-allocation','--affine-control','absent','--table','absent'],'explicit paired artifacts'),
       ('declared-pieces',{'affine_allocation':'piecewise'},affine+['--piecewise-allocation'],'cannot read evaluation input'),
       ('legacy-with-plan',{'engine_plan':False},common,'protocol differs'),
       ('planned-without-flag',{},['--draft-depth','2'],'protocol differs'),
       ('over-resource-bound',{'memory_bytes':25_000_000_000},common,'protocol differs'),
       ('unrepresented-fraction',{'memory_bytes':14_000_000_001},common,'protocol differs'),
       ('wrong-draft-depth',{'draft_depth':1},common,'freeze its explicit draft'),
       ('wrong-draft-placement',{'draft_experts':'resident'},common,'freeze its explicit draft'),
       ('no-draft',{'draft_depth':0},['--engine-plan','--streamed-draft','--draft-depth','0'],'explicit paired artifacts'),
       ('other-format',{},common+['--source-directory','absent','--source-inventory','absent'],'explicit paired artifacts'),
       ('accepted-header',{},common,'cannot read evaluation input')]
save()
for name,changes,flags,message in cases:
 p=copy.deepcopy(protocol);p.update(changes);path=out/(name+'.json');path.write_text(json.dumps(p))
 dest=out/(name+'-output')
 command=[str(cli),'quantization-task-run','--protocol-file',str(path),'--protocol-sha256',sha(path),
          '--baseline',str(out/'intentionally-absent-weights'),'--output',str(dest)]+flags
 done=subprocess.run(command,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 (out/(name+'.log')).write_text(done.stdout+done.stderr)
 passed=done.returncode!=0 and message in done.stderr and not dest.exists()
 record['cases'].append({'name':name,'command':command,'exit_code':done.returncode,'expected':message,'passed':passed});save()
 assert passed,name
record['complete']=True;save();print(json.dumps({'complete':True,'cases':len(cases)}))
````
